name: Israel In The Last Days
overview: Scripture reveals that in the last days, God will sovereignly gather Israel as one unified nation under one king, ending division among them (Ezekiel 37:22). This restoration will be accompanied by a time of unprecedented trouble, yet God’s protection through the prince Michael will ensure the deliverance of His people (Daniel 12:1). Jerusalem will become a focal point of conflict and divine judgment, described as a 'cup of trembling' to surrounding nations (Zechariah 12:2), culminating in the coming day of the Lord when spoil will be divided within Israel (Zechariah 14:1). Throughout this period, God’s comfort and faithfulness to His people remain certain (Isaiah 40:1), even as He pleads for His scattered heritage among the nations (Joel 3:2).
